name: const_so101

No real-robot runs yet. Not checked on the two-camera checkpoint or with markers.
alpha_unit: module scale: median L2 norm of text-token activations at this layer (fit set)
cameras: one view (wrist, cam0); the policy_checkpoint check cannot tell 1cam from 2cam, use the -1cam checkpoint
k_note: k scales the edit, alpha = k * alpha_unit_value; k = 1 is the calibrated vector (scale * w, norm 54.0) and the chosen k
calibration: steervla runs/steering_so101/results.md (offline proxy, held-out real frames): the barrier beat this constant (barrier/constant loss ratio 0.65); constant = alpha * w with alpha = k * alpha_unit_value, k = 1 calibrated
